Answer A never limits the line length, so it fails the 60-75 character criterion. Answer B caps paragraphs and captions at 65ch, though it hard-codes line-heights instead of making them custom properties. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers give pasteable rem values with unitless line-heights, scale h1 from 40px to 30px on mobile, and handle the headings, caption and code well. A's cap sits on p and figcaption rather than the article container, so it falls a little short of full marks.
